kjv: Wherefore I abhor [myself], and repent in dust and ashes
mine: therefore I reject my words and am consoled, here in dust and ashes
note: 'em'as has no object in Hebrew (KJV supplies "myself"), and nihamti 'al can mean "repent of" or "be comforted concerning"; whether Job confesses guilt or retracts his lawsuit and accepts consolation is the central interpretive crux of the book.

kjv: the LORD turned the captivity of Job
mine: Yahweh restored the fortunes of Job
note: shav 'et-shevut is an idiom "restore the fortunes" (Deut 30:3, Ps 126:4); Job was never a captive.
